title: Pickup slots
intro: Slots are 30-minute windows inside your pickup window. Each slot takes a limited number of orders so nobody queues for long. A full slot is greyed out for customers.

empty.title: No slots for this day
empty.text: Generate the slots for a market day and customers can start booking a pickup time.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.note: Change the window and days under Stall & pickup. Slots for a day are created from them.

closing.title: Closing a slot
closing.text: Turning a slot off hides it from new orders. Orders already in it stay; contact those customers if you cannot make it.

away.title: Days you are not selling
away.intro: A market day you will miss — a short harvest, illness, a van that will not start. Your stall drops off the market page for that day and takes no new orders. Orders already placed are declined with your reason, and the stock goes back to you (D-02).
away.backText: You are selling that day again. Declined orders are not brought back; the customer has to order again.
away.emptyTitle: You are selling on every market day
away.emptyText: Tell customers in advance if that changes, so nobody turns up to an empty stall.
away.declinedText_one: {{count}} order declined and the customer told.
away.declinedText_other: {{count}} orders declined and the customers told.
away.toldText: Customers can no longer order from you for {{date}}.
away.dialogText: Orders already placed for that day are declined with your reason and the stock returns to you. The customer is told straight away and pays nothing, because nothing is paid until pickup.
away.seedReason: Harvest was short after the rain

closure.title: The market itself is shut on {{date}}.
closure.text: {{reason}}. You do not need to do anything: nobody can order from any stall for that day, and MarketLink has told your customers.

generate.title: Generate slots for {{from}} – {{to}}?
generate.text: Creates slots from {{start}} to {{end}} on {{daysA}} at Thảo Điền and on {{daysB}} at Thủ Đức. Existing slots are not changed.
